name: InvoiceFlow
description: A command-line tool for transforming invoice export files into normalized JSON and CSV formats. Supports schema validation, configurable field mapping, and batch processing, making it useful for finance and back-office automation workflows.
sideNote: Created as a sample automation tool for data transformation and CLI workflow design.

name: TrailNotes
description: A web application for organizing travel notes, saved places, and short trip summaries. Includes client-side routing, responsive layouts, local persistence, and lightweight filtering for a smooth mobile-first experience.
sideNote: Built as a sample frontend project focused on usability, responsive design, and local-first interaction.

name: StockRoom
description: A dashboard concept for tracking office equipment, stock levels, and internal requests. Features searchable tables, status filters, reusable UI components, and clean visual hierarchy for admin workflows.
sideNote: Designed as a sample internal tool interface for inventory and operations management.
